questions.question: When Korah and his followers rebelled against Moses and Aaron, what did they say about the whole congregation?

answers.text: They're all holy and the LORD is in their midst
They're all weary and the LORD has heard their cry
They're all ready and the LORD will raise new leaders

questions.question: Moses told Korah and the Levites that God had already brought them near. What else were they seeking?

answers.text: A bigger share of the offerings

questions.question: To prove God had sent him, what did Moses say would happen to the rebel Korah and his men?

answers.text: The earth would open and swallow them
A flood would sweep their tents away
A storm would tear their tents down

questions.question: When a plague spread through Israel after Korah's rebellion, where did Aaron stand with his incense?

answers.text: Between the living and the dead
Beside the altar inside the Tent
At the far edge of the camp
